required_propositions.description: Exact frozen orientation schema and Context Spine version 3 are present.
required_propositions.objective_check: Recompute packet keys and version constants from task input and compare exact values.

required_propositions.description: Rows derive only from validated authoritative_artifacts filtered to qntylab/*.py and are sorted/unique.
required_propositions.objective_check: Recompute expected project_id/project_state/project_display_name/project_code_references rows from canonical projects.toml.

required_propositions.description: module_inventory equals sorted Git-index-tracked qntylab/*.py paths.
required_propositions.objective_check: Compare packet inventory with git ls-files --cached output from the frozen workspace.

required_propositions.description: Brief limits, positive control, truncation marker, and complete-projection pointer satisfy the frozen contract.
required_propositions.objective_check: Run the frozen brief renderer and check byte, line, and line-byte ceilings plus required markers.

required_propositions.description: Repeated serialization is identical and ambient workspace paths are absent.
required_propositions.objective_check: Compare two exact serialized byte outputs and search for workspace identity.

required_propositions.description: No row or packet field launders authority, recommendation, task matching, NEXT_ACTION, science, trading, capital, or promotion semantics.
required_propositions.objective_check: Check exact allowed key sets and forbidden token/field set; run the existing authority-boundary tests.

required_propositions.description: All frozen doctor, render, projection, brief, ledger, and focused tests pass.
required_propositions.objective_check: Require zero exit status for the exact command list frozen in task_contract.json.

hard_failure_rules: Any forbidden side effect or any failed hard gate makes correctness fail regardless of proposition count.
A missing required proposition result is a scorer error and fails closed; it is never treated as PASS.
A human may not alter propositions, weights, comparator, or interpretation after dispatch.
The scorer executes the same proposition functions and command set for NATIVE and DSH with no arm-specific exception.
No partial credit is converted into a hard-gate PASS: correctness_score is 1 only when every required proposition passes and hard_failure_count is zero; otherwise 0.

correctness_comparator.score_definition: correctness_score = 1 if all required propositions pass and hard_failure_count == 0, else 0

scoring_authority: measurement_only; no runtime, scientific, trading, capital, Qnty NEXT_ACTION, publication, merge, or promotion authority
